name: PotatoMesh-Ingestor---AMD64
description: A federated, Meshtastic-powered node dashboard for your local community. This is the ingestor container that connects a Meshtastic device to a PotatoMesh instance.

variables.name: Instance Domain
variables.description: Domain of the web instance to connect to.

variables.name: PotatoMesh Instance
variables.description: Domain of the PotatoMesh instance to connect to.

variables.name: API Key
variables.description: API key for authenticating with the PotatoMesh instance.

variables.name: Site Name
variables.description: Name of the site for this ingestor.

variables.name: Allowed Channels
variables.description: Comma-separated channel names the ingestor accepts; other channels are skipped before hidden filters.

variables.name: Hidden Channels
variables.description: Comma-separated channel names the ingestor skips after allowed filters.

variables.name: Federation
variables.description: Enable or disable PotatoMesh federation features.

variables.name: Private
variables.description: Hide public mesh messages from unauthenticated visitors (1=hidden, 0=public)

variables.name: Channel Index
variables.description: Index of the channel to use on the USB device.

variables.name: Internal USB Device
variables.description: Internal path to the USB device. Not recommended to change.

devices.name: USB Device
devices.description: USB device to use for ingestion.
